'''Meelee''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|girl]] who was in attendance at the [[Festival of Four Honorings]] at [[Marblewood Estate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] during the [[Marblewood Estate heist]]. She bumped into [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] who used the contact as an excuse to drop a fake [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] into a sand tornado as part of the heist he set up. Her parents did not realize that the impact had been staged and scolded the poor girl.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
